title: Northing
summary: NORTH'ING, noun 1. The motion or distance of a planet from the equator northward. As the tides of the sea obey the southing and northing of the sea-- 2. Course or distance northward of the equator. NO

inlines.v: NORTH'ING, noun 1. The motion or distance of a planet from the equator northward. As the tides of the sea obey the southing and northing of the sea-- 2. Course or distance northward of the equator. NORTH'-STAR, noun The north polar star.
